_about: Hand annotation layer. Everything here is information the atlas needs and the source does not state in a form a tool can read. Each entry is a gap.

driver_prefixes.why: Which modules are test or tool drivers rather than the renderer is a project judgment; neither the module graph nor the declarations mark it.

indexes.source: pkg::dom::store_text doc: 'Copies text into the document's text storage and returns its span'
pkg::style::build_traversal doc: 'Returns document's Element nodes in tree order (preorder)'
pkg::style::build_traversal doc: 'parents holds, at each element's preorder index, its parent element's preorder index, or the number of elements'
pkg::style::build_traversal doc: 'order holds, at each node's NodeId index, that element's preorder index, or 4294967295'
pkg::style::intern_styles doc: 'returns every element's identifiers in preorder'
pkg::style::intern_styles doc: 'order is a copy of traversal's'
pkg::style::intern_styles doc: 'Interns each of the eleven value groups in its own table'
pkg::style::intern_styles doc: 'the custom identifier is the first set with the element's entries'
inferred; pkg::style::match_elements doc: 'each pseudo-element's parent being its element' does not say which index space
pkg::layout::StyleRef doc: 'the computed style of the element whose NodeId index is element (root_element for the root element's)'
pkg::layout::StyleRef doc: 'entry pseudo of the style stage's pseudo-element list when pseudo is not no_pseudo'
pkg::layout::Flow doc: 'Open and Close bracket a block-level box of the context's blocks'
inferred; pkg::layout::Flow doc: 'Child is an in-flow block-level child context' names no table
pkg::layout::Block doc: 'parent is the block it sits in (no_index when it sits directly in the context)'
pkg::layout::place_boxes doc: 'owner the element's NodeId index' or 'the text node's NodeId index', chosen by kind

tour.why: The source has no place for any of this: modules and modules.wfg take no doc, the renderer has no top-level function that states its pipeline (only test drivers call the stages in order), and nothing names a group of functions as one phase.
tour.sentence: Snowghost turns HTML, CSS and fonts into the position of every box on the page.
tour.unbuilt: Not built yet: paint, compositing and the shell that puts pixels on screen.

nodes.title: Parse HTML
nodes.summary: Turns the HTML bytes into the document tree.

nodes.title: Style
nodes.summary: Works out the value of every CSS property for every element.

nodes.title: List the elements
nodes.summary: Puts the elements in tree order, so later steps can loop over them.

nodes.title: Collect the rules
nodes.summary: Parses every style sheet, style attribute and presentational attribute into one store.

nodes.title: Compute the styles
nodes.summary: Matches rules to elements and computes each element's values.

nodes.title: Fonts
nodes.summary: Loads the font files and picks the faces each style asks for.

nodes.title: Layout
nodes.summary: Builds the boxes, breaks text into lines and gives every box a position.

nodes.title: Edit the document
nodes.summary: One of these changes the document in place.

nodes.title: Restyle
nodes.summary: Computes the styles again and finds which elements changed in a way layout reads. A text edit skips this.

nodes.title: Mark what changed
nodes.summary: One of these, by kind of edit, marks the paragraphs and contexts to redo.

nodes.title: Update the layout
nodes.summary: Redoes only what is marked, then reports the positions again.
